Rina Gomez: Quick flag: recruiting ops reported several interviewers couldn't find the new calibration guide attached to panel invites this morning. Some interviewers said the scorecard version didn't match the guidance doc.
Avery Brooks: Which panels? any candidate impact?
Rina Gomez: Panels 9011, 9012, 9020. A couple of interviews started without scorecards visible.
Samir Khan: I see an importer warning at 08:02: scorecard_version mismatch (expected v3, got v2). The importer currently blocks shadow updates when versions differ.
Priya Desai: We intentionally incremented the guide to v3 last week (clarified rubrics). But we didn't push the metadata bump to ATS connector for older panels. Oops.
Rina Gomez: Can we reconcile quickly? Hiring teams need consistent scoring today.
Samir Khan: Fast plan: 1) temporary relax strict version check so v2 cards load (hotfix), 2) run a targeted upgrade for listed panels to attach v3 metadata, 3) follow-up migration to convert legacy scorecards to v3 format. I'll open a canary patch now.
Avery Brooks: Also can we add a short note in the interviewer message when panel scorecard was upgraded? So interviewers don't get confused.
Priya Desai: Good idea. I'll add a line to the invite text and notify recruiting ops.
RecruitBot: created ticket R-2026-678: "Scorecard version mismatch blocks panel attachments" assigned to Samir Khan due 2026-06-20
Samir Khan: Hotfix pushed to canary. ETA 25m to monitor. I'll post backfill command and results here once done.
Rina Gomez: Thanks. Please paste any failure counts after backfill so I can confirm with HR.
Samir Khan: Will do.
